definitions.gloss: city center; downtown area; central district
definitions.explanation: The main commercial and business area of a city or town, where shops, offices, and entertainment are concentrated.

examples.japanese: {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}まで{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: I walked to the city center.

examples.japanese: {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}には{店|みせ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many shops in the downtown area.

examples.japanese: {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}の{再開発|さいかいはつ}が{進|すす}んで、{新|あたら}しいビルが{次々|つぎつぎ}と{建|た}っている。
examples.english: Redevelopment of the city center is underway, and new buildings are going up one after another.

notes:
Compound of {中心|ちゅうしん} (center) + {街|がい} (town, street area). Refers to the main commercial and entertainment hub of a city.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}の{再開発|さいかいはつ}: downtown redevelopment
- {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}に{住|す}む: to live downtown
- {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}の{活性化|かっせいか}: revitalization of the city center
- {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}から{離|はな}れた: away from the center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {繁華街|はんかがい}: entertainment district — specifically the bustling, bright area with shops and nightlife
- {都心|としん}: city center — specifically the center of a large metropolis like Tokyo
- {商店街|しょうてんがい}: shopping street — a specific street or arcade lined with shops
- {市街地|しがいち}: urban area — the built-up area of a city in general
- ダウンタウン: downtown — the English loanword, also used in Japanese
